To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the development of EC/ EB systems is a special software engineering discipline which requires an adapted software development approach.
a new software development processes is required for the development of electronic commerce systems.

the software development processes for EC/EB applications have to take the following factors into consideration: the "time-to market" factor, the high degree of integration, the high degree and complexity of interaction, and a high level of quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new software development model for EC/EB-systems.
the following questions: Which specific characteristics does an EC/EB system have and which requirements does this imply for the development process?
the question of how to develop EC/EB systems efficiently and effectively.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this development process is a very good starting point for the development of electronic commerce systems.
the software development process for electronic commerce systems must be adapted to the new conditions and requirements of EC/EB development.

the development process for electronic commerce portals must be adapted to the special requirements of electronic commerce systems, especially to the high degree of interaction and integration with existing systems, and to the "time-to- market" factor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the software development process for the EC/EB system is based upon an iterative process model, which allows a high degree of reuse and which takes the "market factor" into account.
the adapted development process allows the reduction of the development time by up to 50% while maintaining the same quality of the resulting software product.
the adapted software development process has proven to be a valuable instrument for the development of EC/ EB systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development process for an EC/EB system must be adapted to the specific characteristics of the system to be developed.
a software process must be adapted to the specific requirements of the software to be built.
the adapted software process is a good basis for the development of electronic commerce portals.
